name: @joomengine/mariadb-wasm-bridge
description: MariaDB WebAssembly host bridge and native PDO driver for JoomEngine PHP

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:integration && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:integration: npm run prepare:engine && node --test test/engine-patch.test.mjs test/engine.test.mjs test/bridge.test.mjs
scripts.test:native: npm run prepare:engine && bash native/tests/run.sh && node --test native/tests/database.test.mjs
